szoveg_eredeti:
Perplexity Mac App has improved a ton. Retention has been steadily increasing. Also the only AI app that has support for trying both frontier and local models (hybrid and fully local). https://www.perplexity.ai/personal-computer

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Computer (@AskPerplexity); megjelent: 2026-11-20T19:14:06+00:00; link: https://x.com/AskPerplexity/status/2123857433760243799; média: videó, 17 másodperc]
We've made several improvements to the Perplexity Mac app.

On top of shipping teammates and Multiagent, we've added:

- Faster, more responsive performance
- “Send now” to redirect a running task
- ⌘F to search in tables, Markdown, and previews
- ⌘⇧T to bring back closed tabs
- Quieter notifications by default
